name: typecheck
description: Run one or more typecheck commands for the workspace's toolchain and return each command's result separately. Commands run sequentially in the workspace root. A non-zero exit code is a normal result to read and iterate on, not an error.

detailed: Runs type checking on the workspace.

commands.description: The typecheck commands to run, in order, for the project's toolchain (for example ["bun --bun tsc --noEmit"] or ["cargo check", "cargo clippy"]).

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional per-command timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
